The '''Cularin Medical Authority''' was a medical authority that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When [[Rysko Barnt]] was murdered, the Medical Authority examined his body and claimed that his cause of [[Death/Legends|death]] was blunt force trauma to the head.
